newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Kiat says cross trading parties unknown.
newsitem.headline: Kiat says cross trading parties unknown.

text.p: Indonesia's PT Indah Kiat Pulp and Paper said on Friday it did not know the parties involved in huge cross trades of the company's shares on Thursday and that it was waiting for details.

Senior Indah Kiat official Harsono told Reuters that details would be lodged with Sinartama Gunita, the company entrusted with registering owners of its shares. But he added no details had yet emerged.
Some 231.8 million Indah Kiat shares, slightly over four percent of the company's total equity, were crossed on Thursday.
Sinartama officials declined to give details.

Harsono also said he could not comment on rumours that most of the buying was done by Asia Food and Properties, a Singapore company controlled by Indonesia's Sinar Mas group which also has a controlling stake in Indah Kiat.
On Thursday, Indah Kiat closed unchanged at 1,350 rupiah after touching a day low of 1,000 rupiah and a day high of 1,425 rupiah on the cross board.
On Friday, Indah Kiat was up 25 rupiah to close at 1,375 rupiah, with some nine million shares traded on the cross board.
